title: Intrinsic ergodicity for $\mathfrak{B}$-free integers in number fields
summary: Let $K$ be a number field with ring of integers $\mathscr{O}_K$, and let $\mathfrak{B}$ be an Erdős family of ideals in $\mathscr{O}_K$. We prove that the associated $\mathfrak{B}$-free subshift $(X_{\mathfrak{B}},(S_a)_{a\in\mathscr{O}_K})$ is intrinsically ergodic: it carries a unique measure of maximal entropy, which we identify explicitly as a relatively independent extension of the Haar rotation on $\prod_{\mathfrak{b}\in\mathfrak{B}}\mathscr{O}_K/\mathfrak{b}$.
